name: pokt-relay-path-resolver
description: Resolve a POKT service ID to how an agent can reach it: who serves it (suppliers), and the two access paths POKT offers — DIRECT (be your own staked app) and GATEWAY (use a gateway's app). A service with suppliers is callable; the resolver surfaces both paths and, given an agent profile, recommends one. Reference tool for the Agent-Native Service Discovery convention.
